title: Electra
description: A visceral new staging of Sophocles' tragedy, set in a crumbling Glasgow tenement. Directed by Dominic Hill, this reimagining strips the myth to its raw emotional core.

title: Salt
description: A searing debut from Glasgow playwright Rae Morrison about three generations of women on the Ayrshire coast, exploring grief, resilience, and the pull of home.

title: Body of Work
description: Award-winning choreographer Janice Parker returns with a mesmerising solo exploring ageing, memory, and the stories our bodies carry. A Tramway commission.

title: The Chippers
description: A Play, A Pie and A Pint presents this hilarious new comedy about two rival chip shop owners on the same Partick street. Lunch included.

title: Glad Scratch Night #14
description: Four emerging artists share 15-minute works-in-progress in a supportive environment. Featuring new pieces exploring identity, migration, and belonging. BYOB.

title: Futures Festival
description: A weekend festival showcasing work by Glasgow's young theatre-makers aged 16-25. Performances, workshops, and panel discussions across three days.

title: Yerma
description: Lorca's devastating portrait of desire and societal expectation in a bold new translation by Jo Clifford, staged in the Citz's newly restored main auditorium.

title: Tron Scratch Series: Spring
description: Three Scottish companies present 20-minute extracts of ambitious new work. This edition features pieces exploring queer joy, urban rewilding, and AI ethics.

title: Mother Tongues
description: A multilingual devised performance created with Glasgow's refugee and immigrant communities, weaving together stories of language, loss, and new beginnings.

title: NOISE: A Performance Evening
description: An evening of experimental performance and sound art in Glasgow's beloved DIY space. Four artists blur the lines between theatre, music, and visual art.
